# hg workspace

**What this page tells you:** every `hg workspace` subcommand, with its arguments, flags and defaults.

Repository mounts: plan, list, verify, doctor, test.

## Synopsis

```text
hg workspace plan
hg workspace list
hg workspace verify [flags]
hg workspace doctor [flags]
hg workspace test [flags]
```

`--json` prints one JSON document on stdout; narration goes to stderr.

## `hg workspace plan`

```text
hg workspace plan
```

Bindings as normalized records with resolved revisions + per-profile shape/classification.

## `hg workspace list`

```text
hg workspace list
```

The bindings, listed.

## `hg workspace verify`

```text
hg workspace verify [flags]
```

Desired vs observed: mounts, revisions, read-only, markers, credentials, absence for unbound profiles.

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--profile` | `<name>` | — | Narrow to one profile; default is every onboarded profile. |
| `--repository` | `<r>` | — | Narrow to one repository binding. |
| `--gitops` | `<clone>` | — | The GitOps clone to verify against. |
| `--record` | — | — | Write the verification record. |

**Examples**

```bash
hg workspace plan
hg workspace verify --profile research
```

## `hg workspace doctor`

```text
hg workspace doctor [flags]
```

Generated records reproduce from the declaration.

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--dir` | `<repo-path-or-git-url>` | — | The persona/distribution repository to read declarations from. |
| `--deep` | — | — | Add the runtime probes. |

## `hg workspace test`

```text
hg workspace test [flags]
```

The reference scenarios (the workspace-bindings tier).

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--scenario` | `business-context|sre-operation-source` | — | Which reference scenario. |
